summary: People with difficulty speaking or learning to speak can use Jellow, a freely downloadable Android app, to communicate through icons and images. The app benefits individuals with speech and language difficulties, as well as toddlers and early learners. Jellow's colourful icons help children develop word associations and can be used in daily life. The app's interface is simple and easy to learn, with over 1000 icons and 10,000 lines of pre-programmed text. Jellow supports multiple languages and accents, and users can create custom boards with their own icons. This app addresses the needs of individuals with speech and language impairments, primarily in the education and healthcare sectors.
